Short dataset name of a TCGA project

Source: R/cpas_extra_sources.R
short_name.Rd

Prefixes a TCGA project id with "TCGA-". Only the first element of dataset is used, and the input must be a TCGA id ("LUAD" or "TCGA-LUAD") — a GEO accession such as "GSE13507" would come back as "TCGA-GSE13507", which is why GEO cohorts are labelled by their catalog accessions instead.

Usage

short_name(dataset)

Arguments

dataset

TCGA dataset id ("LUAD" or "TCGA-LUAD").

Value

A single string, "TCGA-<PROJECT>" (only the first element of dataset is used).

Examples

  ## Short labels used in figures and tables (TCGA ids only).
  short_name("LUAD")
#> [1] "TCGA-LUAD"
  short_name("TCGA-LUAD")
#> [1] "TCGA-LUAD"
